minute_clock: Each valid completed RTH minute after the original 09:47 opening fill: bar right-edge t, assumed information at t+1 minute, earliest fill at open of the bar starting t+2 minutes, strictly before session close.
capacity_measure: At each minute close, mark frozen own after-opening quantities and cash at observed adjusted prices. Diagnostic cash-to-risk-room is min(current cash weight, max(0, parent current beta cap minus current 3xSOXL+SOXX nominal beta)); beta-neutral rotation room requires positive SOXL and cash. Positive room is only a target-space diagnostic, not a whole-share order or fee-net label.
stop: Do not calculate future returns, fit a model, infer funded order support or choose a trigger threshold from this preflight. Preserve the prior guard and daily 09:46 proposal as closed/superseded in their original scopes.
